nodes.title: PROPOSED (duplex r3): the word-aware end of turn outside closed answers = the pause class of the COVERED words + the transcriber's closing mark (hold shape / enumerating / question / idk / complete) → PAUSE_WAIT {1600, 1200, 900, 0, 1100} ms, and in free / question-to-her / chit-chat that wait IS the G10 backstop. Chosen on eot-bench TRAIN (<= 3 % both lanes). Reverse if the pilot's annotated child pauses show more cut-offs than the shipped path, if a shape class ends >= 10 % of child turns, or if an Azure text model answers in < 300 ms with AUC >= 0.85 on complete-looking pauses

PROPOSED (duplex r3): the engine emits prepare.eager start/cancel on exactly the covered words of a finished-looking turn (Deepgram Flux EagerEndOfTurn / Endpoint Anticipation); the floor decision never waits on it; the consumer is the turn prefetch (relational-human duplexTurn.ts should key on hint.eager, not draft). Reverse if wasted starts exceed 0.5 per turn on prod shadow or the server adopts < 50 % of them

PROPOSED (duplex r3): the hush gives up only on ECHO-LIKE wordless bursts (within OVERLAP.echoNearDb of her echo) and a confirmed burst resets the count (was: any 4 wordless bursts switched the hush off for the whole lesson). Reverse if on-device shadow shows her echo hushing her > 1 per minute with AEC

PROPOSED (duplex r3): an ended burst <= 650 ms with no words is never an acoustic barge-in (rising contour and her yes/no question excepted); it waits, hushed, for its words, which the overlap micro-commit probe fetches in ~0.3-0.6 s. Reverse if child stop requests ('ruko') pause her later than 1 s in > 20 % on the pilot

PROPOSED (duplex r3): an onset over an OPEN reply in the revoke window ARMS the revoke; the overlap classifier fires it (words, sustain) and only a lexical continuer disarms; a pending verdict still revokes at once. Retries rj-dxr-armed-revoke with the hush fixed and word-only disarm. Reverse if AMI / pilot barge-in stops within 200 ms fall below the unarmed arm

PROPOSED (duplex r3): when a burst over her goes quiet for 150 ms the engine sends the micro-commit probe (live only), so continuer vs barge-in vs 'ruko' is decided on words ~0.3-0.6 s after the burst instead of the lane's first-text delay (D4 p90 2.0 s, MAI 3.2 s). Reverse if probes split her echo into child items measurably (shadow echoRemoved per minute doubles)

PROPOSED (duplex r3, fix): an EMPTY final covers its audio in the fan-in (a wordless blip after the last words no longer blocks the decision until backstop + 2 s; eot-bench hi__4361 cold-start fixture 3,080 ms → decided at the empty final)

PROPOSED (duplex r3): TAXILA_DUPLEX_LIVE_FOR (guardian emails or their sha256) gets duplex 'on' from GET /api/duplex/config while TAXILA_DUPLEX=shadow for everyone else; the kill switch wins; a lookup error or > 600 ms answers the global mode; Vary: cookie. Reverse when the switch criteria are met (global on) or if the lookup pushes the route's p90 over 600 ms

PROPOSED (duplex r3, patch 02): a hands-free switch that cannot be read (route missing, > 3 s, error) runs SHADOW, never live; build default 'off' still wins; config timeout 1.5 → 3 s. Reverse only if production goes globally 'on'

duplex r3 E1 (REAL adult Hindi eot-bench, real STT events recorded live 2026-10-07, replayed; US sandbox): cut-offs >= 500 ms MAI 19/147 12.9 % → 6/147 4.1 % [1.9-8.6] (TRAIN 15.6 → 2.6 %, TEST 10.0 → 5.7 %), D4 12/147 8.2 % → 7/147 4.8 % (TEST 7.1 → 5.7 %); gap p50/p90 MAI 910/2278 → 1011/1480, D4 923/2060 → 1019/1511; question to her MAI 6/20 → 1/20 at 434 → 811 ms; free 13/121 → 5/121 at 920 → 1021 ms; no turn worsened

duplex r3 E1 LIVE on the production lane (D4 gpt-live-transcribe eastus2, real time, probes in the loop, n = 400 turns / 147 pauses, 2026-10-09): AFTER 4/147 = 2.7 % [1.1-6.8] cut-offs, gap p50/p90 1362/3069; the round-2 engine replayed on the same events 6/147 = 4.1 %, 1337/2973. The STT was slower that day (commit→final p50 660 / p90 1,700 ms vs 560 / 760 on 2026-10-07): 181 turns waited for the hard backstop in both engines

duplex r3: the device's RMS/YIN voicing clock reads eot-bench pauses ~200 ms longer than the annotation (offset ~100 ms early, onset ~100 ms late; p10/p50/p90 +80/+200/+300 ms, n = 147); device silence-900 with covered words cuts 19/147 = 12.9 % vs the annotation's 7/147 = 4.8 %

duplex r3: both STT lanes close 60-61 % of micro-commit finals with ।/./?; on eot-bench a comma, a broken word or an unclosed number ended 0-4 of 400 turns vs 17-33 thinking pauses (MAI); unclosed plain words are NOT a hold on D4 (9 ends vs 3 pauses)

duplex r3 text-only end-of-turn ceiling (eot-bench, real MAI text at the moment words covered the audio, offline, n = 538 pauses): grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning AUC 0.70 all / 0.57 complete-looking (n 358), p50 563 ms; taxila-fast (gpt-5.6-luna) 0.83 / 0.80, p50 1,219 / p90 1,494 ms; stage A pProjected 0.50 / 0.49; prosody (pitch position) 0.70

duplex r3 eager end of turn (eot-bench replay): fired on the exact committed words at 354/399 (D4) and 336/399 (MAI) turn ends, p50 280 / 560 ms before the commit; 0.96 / 1.21 starts and 0.07 / 0.36 cancelled starts per turn

duplex r3 E2 (REAL adult AMI, real D4 events recorded in round 2, open-loop replay, 4 meetings, 48 pairs; NOT children): continuers kept 139/195 71.3 % → 154/195 79.0 % [72.7-84.1]; barge-ins stopped (hush or yield) within 200 ms 17/51 33 % → 24/51 47 %, p50 among stopped 310 → 160 ms; false yields to room voices 37/239 15.5 % → 32/239 13.4 % (room bursts hushed 14 → 39/239); self-yields on headset bleed 116/730 15.9 % → 101/730 13.8 %. Results evals/duplex-real/results/r3-ami-base.json vs r3-ami-after2.json; scorer evals/duplex-r3/criteria.mjs

duplex r3 TaxilaFDB TEST (SIMULATED child-like TTS, 960 streams x D4/FAST/MAI_HOME, herAct): cut-offs 2.7/2.7/3.4 % unchanged; gap p50 1160/480/370 → 1160/570/540 ms (question / chit-chat waits; no cut-off the sim can show); continuers kept 0.944/0.972/0.958 → 0.986/0.972/0.986; stop <= 200 ms 105/104/105 of 108 unchanged; pause within 1 s 0.556/0.796/0.537 → 0.222/0.685/0.435 with the 1,000 ms hushed sustain (0.509/0.796/0.806 at 600); safety detected 84/84/83 and unsafe 0/0/1 unchanged

duplex r3 (Log Analytics, 2026-10-07..09): production served 512 lesson starts but 5 GET /api/duplex/config and 0 real duplex shadow summaries (only the round-2 test's 3 synthetic posts): voice lessons almost never run, so Gate S cannot fill without them

duplex r3 tests/prod/round3-duplex.mjs on a LOCAL production build (NODE_ENV=production, Neon TEST, fake mic + scripted transcription call in Chromium): 15/15 (cohort page hears on/owner and the engine commits hands-free turns; a non-cohort parent and a 4 s-slow switch stay shadow). taxila.dev before deploy: 6/8 (Vary and the round-3 bundle missing, as expected)

duplex r3: an Azure LLM semantic end-of-turn read in the loop for open speech (re-measured offline with no latency budget): the production fast model separates complete-looking pauses at AUC 0.57; the model that reaches 0.80 answers in 1.2 s, after the 1.1 s wait it would shorten
duplex r3: LiveKit's end-of-turn models (text v0.4.1, audio v1): the LiveKit Model License allows use only inside the LiveKit Agents framework and forbids using outputs to develop other models

duplex: the hush switched off for the WHOLE lesson after 4 wordless bursts. On real AMI meetings continuers and other voices used them up within minutes: 13 of 22 barge-ins (2 meetings) got no hush; her audio kept sounding ~0.5-1.3 s into the speaker

duplex: answering a complete question to her with 0 ms of silence: on real Hindi the speaker went on after '…ठीक है?' / '…ना?' in 6 of 20 (MAI) thinking pauses >= 500 ms; now PAUSE_WAIT.question 900 ms (1/20)
duplex r3: a pitch-rise extension of the complete-class wait: no gain on eot-bench TRAIN at a 3 % budget (the grid chose up = 0 on both lanes)
duplex r3: reading any unpunctuated tail as a hold: on D4 unclosed plain words ended 9 turns vs 3 pauses; only an unclosed NUMBER is a hold

duplex: the hands-free switch failing OPEN to the build default 'on' while production is shadow: on a loaded local production server the page's GET /api/duplex/config never answered within 1.5 s and the lesson went live hands-free without the server's answer (observed 2026-10-09, twice)

PROPOSED (duplex r3): a burst over her that is too close to her own echo to be hushed (echoLikelihood >= 0.5) is never stopped for on acoustics alone; its words decide (src/duplex/overlap.ts, governor.ts G11 threshold 0.7 → 0.5; OVERLAP.acousticYieldNeedsNonEcho). Rationale: AMI 4 meetings +8 continuers (146 → 154/195) for −1 barge-in (25 → 24/51) and +4 bleed yields. Reverse if real CHILD device sessions (AEC on, no headset bleed) show barge-ins that are echo-like by this estimate and go unstopped for > 1 s, or if barge-ins stopped within 200 ms falls below 45 % on the same replay

duplex r3: pausing her after 600 ms of voice while she is already hushed (OVERLAP.hushedSustainMs = sustainedMs): AMI 2 meetings (IS1008b, ES2004b, 24 pairs) bleed self-yields 78 → 94/421 and barge-ins stopped within 200 ms 13 → 10/22, continuers 78 → 73/103; only the SIMULATED TaxilaFDB 'paused within 1 s' prefers it (D4 0.22 → 0.50). Kept 1,000 ms: the hush (105/108 within 200 ms simulated) is the child-facing stop either way

duplex r3 AMI ablations (REAL adult, same recorded D4 events, open-loop replay): armed revoke OFF 4 meetings cont 143/195, barge 25/51, room 35/239, bleed 103/730 (vs on: 146, 25, 32, 97); 2 meetings first-after 72/103, 11/22, 12/101, 79/421; + acousticYieldNeedsNonEcho 78/103, 13/22, 13/101, 78/421; hushedSustainMs 600 73/103, 10/22, 14/101, 94/421. Files evals/duplex-real/results/r3-ami-abl-*.json; runner evals/duplex-r3/ami-overlap.mjs --set

md.decisions:
## duplex round 3 (2026-10-09; inbox context/inbox/r3-duplex.json; docs/design/round3/duplex/)
- **dx3-word-aware-eot-pause-class**: outside closed answers the end of turn waits by the pause class of the covered words (src/duplex/engineRules.ts pauseClass, config.ts PAUSE_WAIT hold 1,600 / enumerating 1,200 / question 900 / idk 0 / complete 1,100 ms; in free, question-to-her and chit-chat the class wait is the G10 backstop). The class reads the transcriber's own closing mark (markers.ts endShape, only once the session's STT has punctuated). Chosen on eot-bench TRAIN, reported on TEST. Reverse: the pilot's child pauses cut more than the shipped path; a shape class ends >= 10 % of child turns; or an Azure text model answers in < 300 ms with AUC >= 0.85.
- **dx3-eager-end-of-turn**: prepare.eager start/cancel on the exact covered words; the floor never waits on it. Reverse: > 0.5 wasted starts per turn on prod shadow, or < 50 % adopted.
- **dx3-hush-giveup-echo-only**, **dx3-ended-short-burst-waits-for-words**, **dx3-armed-revoke-word-disarm**, **dx3-overlap-probe**: overlap is one classifier, reversible (the hush), word-confirmed (the probe). Reversal conditions in the graph rows.
- **dx3-acoustic-yield-needs-nonecho**: an echo-like burst (echoLikelihood >= 0.5) is left to its words, never yielded to on acoustics alone. AMI: +8/195 continuers, −1/51 barge-ins. Reverse on real child device data where such bursts are real barge-ins left unstopped > 1 s.
- **dx3-empty-final-covers**: an empty final covers its audio.
- **dx3-owner-cohort** (TAXILA_DUPLEX_LIVE_FOR) and **dx3-switch-fails-to-shadow** (patch 02): the owner tries hands-free on taxila.dev while production stays shadow; an unreadable switch never turns it on.
md.measurements:
## duplex round 3 measurements (2026-10-09; all REAL ADULT speech or SIMULATED as labelled; never children)
- ms-dx3-eot-bench-replay-2026-10-09: E1 eot-bench Hindi (CC BY 4.0, evaluation only), real STT events recorded 2026-10-07 replayed through the engine; n = 400 turns, 147 pauses >= 500 ms; method evals/duplex-real/eot-replay.mjs + evals/duplex-r3/split.mjs / by-context.mjs. MAI 12.9 → 4.1 % cut-offs, D4 8.2 → 4.8 %; TEST 5.7 % both; gap p50 +~100 ms, p90 −0.6-0.8 s.
- ms-dx3-eot-live-d4-2026-10-09: fresh live D4 run (evals/duplex-real/eot.mjs, 8 shards real time): 4/147 2.7 % vs the old engine on the same events 6/147 4.1 %; slower STT day.
- ms-dx3-device-silence-ruler, ms-dx3-endshape-signal, ms-dx3-sem-ceiling-2026-10-09, ms-dx3-eager-2026-10-09: the pause table (evals/duplex-r3/eot-table.mjs) and its simulator (eot-policy.mjs, reproduces the shipped engine exactly), eot-sem-ceiling.mjs, eager.mjs.
- ms-dx3-ami-overlap-2026-10-09: E2 AMI (CC BY 4.0, evaluation only) 48 pairs, evals/duplex-r3/ami-overlap.mjs (scoring imported from ami-real.mjs). Continuers 139 → 154/195, barge-ins stopped <= 200 ms 17 → 24/51, room false yields 37 → 32/239, bleed self-yields 116 → 101/730 (r3-ami-base vs r3-ami-after2).
- ms-dx3-ami-ablations-2026-10-09: per-row ablations on the same events (armed revoke off; acousticYieldNeedsNonEcho; hushedSustainMs 600), evals/duplex-real/results/r3-ami-abl-*.json.
- ms-dx3-taxilafdb-sim-2026-10-09: SIMULATED regression check, evals/duplex-r3/fdb.mjs (copy of p1-duplex/fdb.mjs) on TEST, before = cadf527's src/duplex + server/duplex.
- ms-dx3-prod-voice-volume-2026-10-09: Log Analytics query (read-only, service principal).
- ms-dx3-owner-path-local-2026-10-09: tests/prod/round3-duplex.mjs local 15/15, taxila.dev 6/8 before deploy.
md.rejected:
## duplex round 3 rejections (2026-10-09)
- rj-dx3-semantic-eot-in-loop: AUC 0.57 for the fast model on complete-looking pauses; 0.80 for one that answers in 1.2 s.
- rj-dx3-livekit-eot-models: licence (LiveKit Agents only).
- rj-dx3-hush-giveup-session-wide: 13/22 real barge-ins got no hush.
- rj-dx3-hushed-sustain-600: AMI 2 meetings bleed self-yields 78 → 94/421, barge-ins stopped 13 → 10/22.
- rj-dx3-question-zero-wait: 6/20 real pauses after a complete question were cut.
- rj-dx3-prosody-modifier-complete, rj-dx3-unclosed-plain-as-hold: no gain / wrong on D4.
- rj-dx3-switch-fails-open: a loaded server's late answer turned a lesson live hands-free.
